user.title: Connect the additional FP400 controller
user.description: First open the FP400 Einrichtung app and complete pairing there. Your FP400 must also remain connected to Home Assistant's existing Matter integration. Submit this dialog to check both connections and match the device by its serial number. Your other Matter devices and your existing server are not changed.

error.cannot_connect: The FP400 Einrichtung app is not reachable. Start it, wait a minute and try again.
error.matter_not_loaded: The existing Matter integration is not ready. Wait until your existing Matter devices are available, then try again.
error.fp400_not_in_matter: No FP400 was found in the existing Matter integration. Add it there first without removing your other devices.
error.fp400_not_paired: The additional controller has no FP400 yet. Complete pairing in the FP400 Einrichtung app, then submit this dialog again.
error.fp400_mismatch: The FP400 on the additional controller cannot be matched unambiguously to your existing Matter device. Check that you shared the same FP400. Do not reset it.
error.fp400_unavailable: The FP400 pairing is stored, but the sensor is not reachable yet. Wait a minute and check the FP400 Einrichtung app. Do not pair or reset the sensor again.

abort.matter_not_loaded: The Matter integration must be set up first.

init.description: Keep this switch enabled to use the FP400 Einrichtung app. Your existing Matter pairing and other devices are preserved. Disable it only to return to the main Matter server; FP400 zones and live positions may then be restricted by that server's vendor ID.

error.cannot_connect: The FP400 Einrichtung app is not reachable. Start it, wait a minute and try again.
error.matter_not_loaded: The existing Matter integration is not ready. Wait until your existing Matter devices are available, then try again.
error.fp400_not_in_matter: No FP400 was found in the existing Matter integration. Add it there first.
error.fp400_not_paired: Complete FP400 pairing in the FP400 Einrichtung app first.
error.fp400_unavailable: The FP400 pairing is stored, but the sensor is currently unreachable. Wait and check the FP400 Einrichtung app; do not pair or reset it again.
error.fp400_mismatch: The additional FP400 cannot be matched unambiguously to your existing Matter device. Share the same device and do not reset it.

set_zones.name: Set zones
set_zones.description: Replaces all detection zones. Cells are [row, column] on the 20-row x 16-column grid (row 0 nearest the sensor, column 8 straight ahead) or a "rows,cols" range such as "3-4,6-10".

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: List of zones with id (1-8), cells and optional enabled flag.

subscribe_location.name: Subscribe to location data
subscribe_location.description: Streams target positions for the given time; the Live tracking switch does this continuously.

start_learning.name: Start background learning
start_learning.description: Starts the AI space background learning (edge and interference recognition).

set_region.name: Set region
set_region.description: Set an entry/exit, interference or monitoring region to a set of grid cells.

cells.name: Cells
cells.description: Cells as [[row, col], ...] or a "rows,cols" range like "3-6,4-8".

clear_region.name: Clear region
clear_region.description: Clear an entry/exit, interference or monitoring region.
